caption_tex: Comparison between the current methods and AlphaEdit. (a) and (d) exhibit the objectives, where $\lambda$ is the coefficient {to keep balance between $e_0$ and $e_1$ in the objective}; (b) and (e) show the distributions of hidden representations after dimensionality reduction within the pre-edited and post-edited LLaMA3, respectively; (c) depicts the output of the post-edited LLaMA3. Best viewed in color.
